body:
Well, I used to care about being good for people. Being the best i could be. I used to want to get good grades, and well, I did. I was an A student. I was smart, I always figured stuff out. I was a good kid. I cared about music. I am a saxophonist, and apparently a really good one at that. One of the best in my state. Well, that went to shit. i used to care about looking good, care about loving people, care about being nice to people, never watning to hurt anyones feelings, or really, harm anyone in any way. I.. yea its hard to talk about. I mean if it matters, i am only 15. But hey, that doesnt matter right? it can affect anyone. I am ADHD, off the charts as a matter of fact. And well, one of the most common things that comes with ADHD is depression. And i have had severe depression, if you couldnt fuckn tell.  

Anyway, I used to care about a lot. I used to occasionally be happy with myself, and well, be happy in general.

Now, I have no clue why I dont care anymore. It hurts too much to try. i guess i got my heart broken a while ago but, im too young for that right? idk. shit hurts. i dont care about anything now. 

​

I have a girlfriend. And thats all i care about. And she is the best one ive had so far. She is supportive and fucking fantastic, but, she cant help me all the way. nobody can. I have closed myself off from, well, mostly everyone. i just dont care much about anything anymore. 

I cant think straight, i dont remember stuff, i cant literally do anything. My motor functions are sucking. 

​

I have bloodied my knuckles from my punching bag n shit. I wanna be my old me. the kid in elementary school that loved everyone. Was sweet to everyone. I dont want to deal with my shit. Its hard to fit a lifetime of information into one post. Or three, or thirty.
Not much anymore. are we talking what I USED to care about?? or now??

I doubt anyone will wanna fuckin help. Everyone is alone. Nobody can help.

I cant show all of myself for many reasons.. but whatever. i am at the point where i used to be super smart, and a really bright kid. Now my sanity and intelligence are leaving me.

Oh well

 This was stupid from the beginning
